question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She always looks on the ______ side of life, no matter how tough things get.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bright**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**bright**" means optimistic or cheerful. (उज्ज्वल/आशावादी)
 
• Someone who always looks on the bright side of life remains positive even during tough times.
 
• The other options: "**negative**," "**dark**," and "**neutral**" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She always looks on the bright__ side of life, no matter how tough things get.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Negative (नकारात्मक)**: means pessimistic or harmful.
 
• **Dark (अंधकारमय)**: means gloomy or pessimistic.
 
• **Neutral (तटस्थ)**: means impartial or not leaning towards any side.
